documents.title: Quillon Q3 Mesh Router: Setup Guide
Quillon QC2 Indoor Camera: User Guide

questions.question: What does a solid amber light on the Q3 router mean?
questions.answer: A solid amber light means the router is powered on but has no internet connection [1].

questions.question: How many satellite nodes can a Q3 network have?
questions.answer: A Q3 network can support up to 6 satellite nodes in addition to the main router [1].

questions.question: How much does Secure Family cost?
questions.answer: Secure Family costs $14.99 per month [1].

questions.question: How far does the QC2 camera's night vision reach?
questions.answer: The QC2 camera's night vision reaches up to 10 metres in complete darkness [1].

questions.question: How many household members can the account owner invite?
questions.answer: The account owner can invite up to 5 household members [1].

questions.question: My router's light keeps blinking red. What's going on?
questions.answer: A flashing red light indicates a hardware fault or a failed firmware update; you should check the error code displayed in the app [1]. If an error code is shown, refer to the Error Codes Reference document for specific troubleshooting steps based on that code [5].

questions.question: If I close my Quillon account, how soon is my camera footage removed?
questions.answer: Your recorded video is deleted immediately when you delete your account [5].

questions.question: How do I wipe everything on my mesh router and start over?
questions.answer: To restore factory settings, press and hold the recessed reset button on the back of the router with a paperclip for 10 seconds until the light starts pulsing blue. This process erases your Wi-Fi name, password, guest network, and parental controls [1]. You will then need to set up the router again in the app [1].

questions.question: Will I lose my settings if I just power cycle the router?
questions.answer: No, restarting the router by unplugging it for 30 seconds and plugging it back in will not erase your settings [1].

questions.question: E-204
questions.answer: E-204 indicates that the router did not receive an IP address from the modem. To resolve this, restart the modem first, wait two minutes, then restart the router [1].

questions.question: C-12 on my camera
questions.answer: C-12 indicates that the camera does not recognize the microSD card. You should use a card of 256 GB or less and ensure it is formatted as exFAT [1].

questions.question: How do I fix E-102?
questions.answer: To fix E-102, re-enter your PPPoE username and password from your provider under Settings, then Internet [1].

questions.question: What's included in Secure Basic?
questions.answer: Secure Basic costs $4.99 per month and includes malware blocking and parental controls [1].

questions.question: How much is Secure Plus, and how many cameras does its cloud video cover?
questions.answer: Secure Plus costs $9.99 per month [1]. Its cloud video history covers up to 4 cameras for 30 days [1], though the user guide notes that with this plan, recordings are kept in the cloud for 14 days [2].

questions.question: What do I need for a warranty claim, and can Secure Family subscribers get a replacement before sending the faulty one back?
questions.answer: To make a warranty claim, you need your order number (or another proof of purchase) and the serial number from the bottom of the device [1]. Yes, Secure Family subscribers can receive an advance replacement before sending back the faulty device [1].

questions.question: How many days do I have to return an unopened router for a full refund?
questions.answer: Passage [1] states that unopened Quillon products can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Passage [3] states that any Quillon product can be returned within 60 days for a full refund.

questions.question: What are your phone support hours?
questions.answer: Passage [1] states that phone support is available Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Eastern Time. Passage [2] states that phone support is available Monday to Saturday, 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. Eastern Time.

questions.question: What time do automatic firmware updates install on the Q3?
questions.answer: Passage [1] states that automatic updates are installed between 3 a.m. and 5 a.m., while Passage [2] states they are installed between 2 a.m. and 4 a.m.
